get.description:
Retrieve the processing status and metadata for a specific dataset. This endpoint allows you to programmatically check the current status of a dataset—including readiness, progress, and metadata—using its unique dataset_id.

**Status Values:**
- `NEW`: Dataset created but not yet processing
- `PRE_PROCESSING`: Being prepared for processing
- `INITIALIZING`: Processing is being initialized
- `UPLOADING`: Data is being uploaded
- `SAVING`: Dataset data is being saved
- `INDEXING`: Being indexed for search and retrieval
- `READY`: Fully processed and ready for use
- `FATAL_ERROR`: Processing error occurred
- `ENRICHING`: Being enriched with additional metadata

💡 **Tip:** Use this endpoint to track dataset readiness before continuing with enrichment, filtering, or export operations.

📖 **Related Guide:** See [archived documentation](api-reference/archive/retrieve-dataset-status.mdx) for detailed examples.

parameters.name: vql

schema.description:
Visual Query Language (VQL) for advanced dataset filtering with type-safe composition and automatic validation. 
            
            VQL is a structured query language for filtering image datasets with precise syntax validation and SQL generation. Submit queries as JSON array or RISON-encoded string for URL safety.

            **Query Structure:** Array of filter objects where each object contains exactly one filter type. Multiple filters are combined with AND logic across the array.
            
            **Filter Type Reference:**
            
            • **entity_type**: Filter by media type
              - Syntax: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is|is_not", "value": "IMAGES|OBJECTS"}}`
              - Example: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is", "value": "IMAGES"}}`
              
            • **labels**: Filter by classification labels (from ML models)
              - Syntax: `{"labels": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["label1", "label2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "unlabeled" in value array to match items without labels
              - Example: `{"labels": {"op": "one_of", "value": ["car", "vehicle"]}}`
              
            • **tags**: Filter by user-defined UUID tags  
              - Syntax: `{"tags": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["uuid1", "uuid2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "untagged" in value array to match items without user tags
              - Example: `{"tags": {"op": "is", "value": ["7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad"]}}`
              
            • **issues**: Filter by quality issues detected by analysis pipeline
              - Syntax: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur|dark|bright|mislabels|outliers|label_outlier|normal", "confidence_min": 0.8, "confidence_max": 1.0, "mode": "in|out"}}`
              - confidence_min/max: Optional range [0.8-1.0] (UI displays as 0.0-1.0 but backend normalizes)
              - mode: "in" to include issues, "out" to exclude them
              - Example: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur", "mode": "out", "confidence_min": 0.8}}`
              
            • **text**: Full-text or semantic search on captions/descriptions
              - Syntax: `{"text": {"op": "fts|semantic", "value": "search text", "threshold": 0.7, "include_labels": true}}`
              - fts: Full-text search with stemming and ranking
              - semantic: Vector similarity search using embedding models
              - threshold: Optional similarity threshold for semantic search
              - include_labels: Extend search to include label text
              - Example: `{"text": {"op": "semantic", "value": "outdoor landscape", "threshold": 0.7}}`
              
            • **similarity**: Find visually similar media using reference image
              - Syntax: `{"similarity": {"op": "media|upload", "value": "reference_uuid", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              - media: Reference existing media by UUID
              - upload: Reference uploaded image for similarity search
              - threshold: Optional cosine distance threshold (lower = more similar)
              - Example: `{"similarity": {"op": "media", "value": "7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              
            • **file/folder**: Path-based filtering on original file locations
              - file: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "pattern" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - folder: `{"folder": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "path" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - Example: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with", "value": "IMG_"}}`
              
            • **size**: Dimensional filtering for objects/images (pixel area)
              - Syntax: `{"size": {"op": "gt|lt|gte|lte", "value": 1000}}`
              - value: Pixel area (width × height) 
              - Example: `{"size": {"op": "gt", "value": 2000}}`
              
            • **duplicates**: Cluster by similarity threshold using precomputed analysis
              - Syntax: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              - value: Similarity threshold [0.8-1.0]
              - Example: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              
            • **uniqueness**: Filter by precomputed uniqueness scores from diversity analysis
              - Syntax: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              - value: Minimum uniqueness score [0.0-1.0]
              - Example: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              
            • **custom_metadata**: Filter by user-defined metadata fields
              - Syntax: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_id": "uuid", "field_name": "name", "field_type": "string|float|enum|datetime|link", "op": "contains|eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of|between", "value": "any"}}`
              - Operators vary by field_type (string: contains, float: gt/lt/eq, enum: one_of, datetime: between)
              - Example: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_name": "quality_score", "field_type": "float", "op": "gte", "value": 8.0}}`
              
            • **created_at**: Filter by media creation timestamp
              - Syntax: `{"created_at": {"op": "eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|between", "value": "timestamp"}}`
              - value: ISO 8601 timestamp string (e.g., "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z") or tuple for 'between'
              - Example: `{"created_at": {"op": "gte", "value": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}`
              - Example (between): `{"created_at": {"op": "between", "value": ["2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"]}}`
            
            **Format Options:** 
            - JSON Array (recommended): Standard JSON array of filter objects
            - RISON String: URL-safe encoded format for query parameters
            
            **Query Semantics:** Multiple filters use AND logic. Each filter object must contain exactly one filter type.
            
            **Performance Notes:** Queries leverage indexed fields (labels, tags, issues) and dataset partitioning for optimal performance on large datasets.

💡 **Tip:** Make sure the recipient's email matches an existing registered user in your Visual Layer environment.

📖 **Related Guide:** See [archived documentation](api-reference/archive/share-a-dataset-with-another-user.mdx) for more details.

parameters.name: vql

schema.description:
Visual Query Language (VQL) for advanced dataset filtering with type-safe composition and automatic validation. 
            
            VQL is a structured query language for filtering image datasets with precise syntax validation and SQL generation. Submit queries as JSON array or RISON-encoded string for URL safety.

            **Query Structure:** Array of filter objects where each object contains exactly one filter type. Multiple filters are combined with AND logic across the array.
            
            **Filter Type Reference:**
            
            • **entity_type**: Filter by media type
              - Syntax: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is|is_not", "value": "IMAGES|OBJECTS"}}`
              - Example: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is", "value": "IMAGES"}}`
              
            • **labels**: Filter by classification labels (from ML models)
              - Syntax: `{"labels": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["label1", "label2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "unlabeled" in value array to match items without labels
              - Example: `{"labels": {"op": "one_of", "value": ["car", "vehicle"]}}`
              
            • **tags**: Filter by user-defined UUID tags  
              - Syntax: `{"tags": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["uuid1", "uuid2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "untagged" in value array to match items without user tags
              - Example: `{"tags": {"op": "is", "value": ["7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad"]}}`
              
            • **issues**: Filter by quality issues detected by analysis pipeline
              - Syntax: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur|dark|bright|mislabels|outliers|label_outlier|normal", "confidence_min": 0.8, "confidence_max": 1.0, "mode": "in|out"}}`
              - confidence_min/max: Optional range [0.8-1.0] (UI displays as 0.0-1.0 but backend normalizes)
              - mode: "in" to include issues, "out" to exclude them
              - Example: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur", "mode": "out", "confidence_min": 0.8}}`
              
            • **text**: Full-text or semantic search on captions/descriptions
              - Syntax: `{"text": {"op": "fts|semantic", "value": "search text", "threshold": 0.7, "include_labels": true}}`
              - fts: Full-text search with stemming and ranking
              - semantic: Vector similarity search using embedding models
              - threshold: Optional similarity threshold for semantic search
              - include_labels: Extend search to include label text
              - Example: `{"text": {"op": "semantic", "value": "outdoor landscape", "threshold": 0.7}}`
              
            • **similarity**: Find visually similar media using reference image
              - Syntax: `{"similarity": {"op": "media|upload", "value": "reference_uuid", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              - media: Reference existing media by UUID
              - upload: Reference uploaded image for similarity search
              - threshold: Optional cosine distance threshold (lower = more similar)
              - Example: `{"similarity": {"op": "media", "value": "7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              
            • **file/folder**: Path-based filtering on original file locations
              - file: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "pattern" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - folder: `{"folder": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "path" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - Example: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with", "value": "IMG_"}}`
              
            • **size**: Dimensional filtering for objects/images (pixel area)
              - Syntax: `{"size": {"op": "gt|lt|gte|lte", "value": 1000}}`
              - value: Pixel area (width × height) 
              - Example: `{"size": {"op": "gt", "value": 2000}}`
              
            • **duplicates**: Cluster by similarity threshold using precomputed analysis
              - Syntax: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              - value: Similarity threshold [0.8-1.0]
              - Example: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              
            • **uniqueness**: Filter by precomputed uniqueness scores from diversity analysis
              - Syntax: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              - value: Minimum uniqueness score [0.0-1.0]
              - Example: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              
            • **custom_metadata**: Filter by user-defined metadata fields
              - Syntax: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_id": "uuid", "field_name": "name", "field_type": "string|float|enum|datetime|link", "op": "contains|eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of|between", "value": "any"}}`
              - Operators vary by field_type (string: contains, float: gt/lt/eq, enum: one_of, datetime: between)
              - Example: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_name": "quality_score", "field_type": "float", "op": "gte", "value": 8.0}}`
              
            • **created_at**: Filter by media creation timestamp
              - Syntax: `{"created_at": {"op": "eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|between", "value": "timestamp"}}`
              - value: ISO 8601 timestamp string (e.g., "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z") or tuple for 'between'
              - Example: `{"created_at": {"op": "gte", "value": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}`
              - Example (between): `{"created_at": {"op": "between", "value": ["2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"]}}`
            
            **Format Options:** 
            - JSON Array (recommended): Standard JSON array of filter objects
            - RISON String: URL-safe encoded format for query parameters
            
            **Query Semantics:** Multiple filters use AND logic. Each filter object must contain exactly one filter type.
            
            **Performance Notes:** Queries leverage indexed fields (labels, tags, issues) and dataset partitioning for optimal performance on large datasets.

parameters.name: vql

schema.description:
Visual Query Language (VQL) for advanced dataset filtering with type-safe composition and automatic validation. 
            
            VQL is a structured query language for filtering image datasets with precise syntax validation and SQL generation. Submit queries as JSON array or RISON-encoded string for URL safety.

            **Query Structure:** Array of filter objects where each object contains exactly one filter type. Multiple filters are combined with AND logic across the array.
            
            **Filter Type Reference:**
            
            • **entity_type**: Filter by media type
              - Syntax: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is|is_not", "value": "IMAGES|OBJECTS"}}`
              - Example: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is", "value": "IMAGES"}}`
              
            • **labels**: Filter by classification labels (from ML models)
              - Syntax: `{"labels": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["label1", "label2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "unlabeled" in value array to match items without labels
              - Example: `{"labels": {"op": "one_of", "value": ["car", "vehicle"]}}`
              
            • **tags**: Filter by user-defined UUID tags  
              - Syntax: `{"tags": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["uuid1", "uuid2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "untagged" in value array to match items without user tags
              - Example: `{"tags": {"op": "is", "value": ["7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad"]}}`
              
            • **issues**: Filter by quality issues detected by analysis pipeline
              - Syntax: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur|dark|bright|mislabels|outliers|label_outlier|normal", "confidence_min": 0.8, "confidence_max": 1.0, "mode": "in|out"}}`
              - confidence_min/max: Optional range [0.8-1.0] (UI displays as 0.0-1.0 but backend normalizes)
              - mode: "in" to include issues, "out" to exclude them
              - Example: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur", "mode": "out", "confidence_min": 0.8}}`
              
            • **text**: Full-text or semantic search on captions/descriptions
              - Syntax: `{"text": {"op": "fts|semantic", "value": "search text", "threshold": 0.7, "include_labels": true}}`
              - fts: Full-text search with stemming and ranking
              - semantic: Vector similarity search using embedding models
              - threshold: Optional similarity threshold for semantic search
              - include_labels: Extend search to include label text
              - Example: `{"text": {"op": "semantic", "value": "outdoor landscape", "threshold": 0.7}}`
              
            • **similarity**: Find visually similar media using reference image
              - Syntax: `{"similarity": {"op": "media|upload", "value": "reference_uuid", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              - media: Reference existing media by UUID
              - upload: Reference uploaded image for similarity search
              - threshold: Optional cosine distance threshold (lower = more similar)
              - Example: `{"similarity": {"op": "media", "value": "7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              
            • **file/folder**: Path-based filtering on original file locations
              - file: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "pattern" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - folder: `{"folder": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "path" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - Example: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with", "value": "IMG_"}}`
              
            • **size**: Dimensional filtering for objects/images (pixel area)
              - Syntax: `{"size": {"op": "gt|lt|gte|lte", "value": 1000}}`
              - value: Pixel area (width × height) 
              - Example: `{"size": {"op": "gt", "value": 2000}}`
              
            • **duplicates**: Cluster by similarity threshold using precomputed analysis
              - Syntax: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              - value: Similarity threshold [0.8-1.0]
              - Example: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              
            • **uniqueness**: Filter by precomputed uniqueness scores from diversity analysis
              - Syntax: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              - value: Minimum uniqueness score [0.0-1.0]
              - Example: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              
            • **custom_metadata**: Filter by user-defined metadata fields
              - Syntax: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_id": "uuid", "field_name": "name", "field_type": "string|float|enum|datetime|link", "op": "contains|eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of|between", "value": "any"}}`
              - Operators vary by field_type (string: contains, float: gt/lt/eq, enum: one_of, datetime: between)
              - Example: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_name": "quality_score", "field_type": "float", "op": "gte", "value": 8.0}}`
              
            • **created_at**: Filter by media creation timestamp
              - Syntax: `{"created_at": {"op": "eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|between", "value": "timestamp"}}`
              - value: ISO 8601 timestamp string (e.g., "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z") or tuple for 'between'
              - Example: `{"created_at": {"op": "gte", "value": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}`
              - Example (between): `{"created_at": {"op": "between", "value": ["2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"]}}`
            
            **Format Options:** 
            - JSON Array (recommended): Standard JSON array of filter objects
            - RISON String: URL-safe encoded format for query parameters
            
            **Query Semantics:** Multiple filters use AND logic. Each filter object must contain exactly one filter type.
            
            **Performance Notes:** Queries leverage indexed fields (labels, tags, issues) and dataset partitioning for optimal performance on large datasets.

get.description:
Initiate an asynchronous export of your dataset. This endpoint triggers the export process and returns a task ID that you can use to monitor progress via the export status endpoint. Export datasets directly using curl without needing Python or SDKs—ideal for automation scripts or CLI-based workflows.

**Query Parameters:**
- `file_name`: Name for the output ZIP file (e.g., 'export.zip')
- `export_format`: Format - `json` or `parquet` (default: json)
- `include_images`: Whether to include image files - `true` or `false` (default: false)

**Workflow:**
1. Call this endpoint to initiate export → receive `export_task_id`
2. Poll `/api/v1/dataset/{dataset_id}/export_status?export_task_id={task_id}`
3. When status is `COMPLETED`, download from the provided `download_uri`

💡 **Tip:** Set `include_images=false` for faster metadata-only exports.

📖 **Related Guide:** See [archived documentation](api-reference/archive/exporting-a-dataset-via-curl-from-visual-layer.mdx) for complete automation scripts.

get.description:
Monitor the progress of an asynchronous dataset export operation. Poll this endpoint using the `export_task_id` returned from the export initiation endpoint.

**Query Parameters:**
- `export_task_id`: The task ID returned from `/api/v1/dataset/{dataset_id}/export_context_async`

**Response includes:**
- `status`: Current state - `PENDING`, `PROCESSING`, `COMPLETED`, or `FAILED`
- `download_uri`: S3 download link (available when status is `COMPLETED`)
- `progress`: Completion percentage (if available)

**Example Workflow:**
```bash
# Poll every 5 seconds until COMPLETED
while [ "$STATUS" != "COMPLETED" ]; do
  curl "https://app.visual-layer.com/api/v1/dataset/{dataset_id}/export_status?export_task_id={task_id}"
  sleep 5
done
```

💡 **Tip:** When downloading from `download_uri`, use `curl -L` to follow S3 redirects.

📖 **Related Guide:** See [archived documentation](api-reference/archive/exporting-a-dataset-via-curl-from-visual-layer.mdx) for complete automation scripts.

get.description:
Explore and search your dataset using AI-powered semantic understanding, natural language captions, or visual similarity. This versatile endpoint returns results based on meaning and context—not just keyword matches.

## Search Types

**Semantic/Caption Search:** Returns results based on the meaning of your query using the `image_caption` parameter. Perfect for finding relevant content using natural language like "dog playing with a ball" or "beach sunset".

**Visual Similarity Search:** Find visually similar items using the `anchor_media_id` parameter with an existing media ID from your dataset.

**Advanced Filtering:** Combine search with filters for labels, tags, issues, and custom metadata.

## Common Query Parameters

- `threshold`: Similarity clustering level - '0' (most inclusive), '1', '2', '3', '4' (most restrictive)
- `entity_type`: 'IMAGES', 'OBJECTS', or 'IMAGES,OBJECTS'
- `image_caption`: Text query for semantic/caption search
- `textual_similarity_threshold`: 0.0-1.0 relevance score threshold for semantic search (e.g., 0.75)
- `anchor_media_id`: UUID for visual similarity searches
- `anchor_type`: 'MEDIA' (existing) or 'UPLOAD' (uploaded search image)
- `labels`: Filter by labels - `["cat","dog"]` or 'unlabeled'
- `tags`: Filter by user tags
- `issues`: Filter by issue type IDs `[1,2,3]`
- `vql`: Visual Query Language for advanced filtering
- `page_number`: Page of results to retrieve (default: 0)

## Examples

**Basic filtering:**
```
/api/v1/explore/{dataset_id}?threshold=0&entity_type=IMAGES&labels=["cat"]
```

**Semantic search:**
```
/api/v1/explore/{dataset_id}?image_caption=dog%20playing%20with%20ball&textual_similarity_threshold=0.75&entity_type=IMAGES
```

**Visual similarity:**
```
/api/v1/explore/{dataset_id}?threshold=0&anchor_type=MEDIA&entity_type=IMAGES&anchor_media_id={media_id}
```

**VQL query:**
```
/api/v1/explore/{dataset_id}?vql=similarity(uuid) > 0.9
```

## Response Structure

Results are organized into clusters of visually similar items. Each cluster contains:
- `clusters`: Groups of visually similar results
- `media`: Items in each cluster with metadata
- `caption`: AI-generated or user-supplied description
- `relevance_score`: Semantic match score (0.0–1.0) for search results

💡 **Tip:** Query without quotes (e.g., `red car`) for loose matches; use quotes (`"red car"`) for more specific matches.

📖 **Related Guides:**
- [Semantic Search](api-reference/archive/semantic-search.mdx)
- [Caption Search](api-reference/archive/caption-search.mdx)
- [Visual Search](api-reference/archive/visual-search.mdx)

schema.description:
Visual Query Language (VQL) for advanced dataset filtering with type-safe composition and automatic validation. 
            
            VQL is a structured query language for filtering image datasets with precise syntax validation and SQL generation. Submit queries as JSON array or RISON-encoded string for URL safety.

            **Query Structure:** Array of filter objects where each object contains exactly one filter type. Multiple filters are combined with AND logic across the array.
            
            **Filter Type Reference:**
            
            • **entity_type**: Filter by media type
              - Syntax: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is|is_not", "value": "IMAGES|OBJECTS"}}`
              - Example: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is", "value": "IMAGES"}}`
              
            • **labels**: Filter by classification labels (from ML models)
              - Syntax: `{"labels": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["label1", "label2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "unlabeled" in value array to match items without labels
              - Example: `{"labels": {"op": "one_of", "value": ["car", "vehicle"]}}`
              
            • **tags**: Filter by user-defined UUID tags  
              - Syntax: `{"tags": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["uuid1", "uuid2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "untagged" in value array to match items without user tags
              - Example: `{"tags": {"op": "is", "value": ["7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad"]}}`
              
            • **issues**: Filter by quality issues detected by analysis pipeline
              - Syntax: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur|dark|bright|mislabels|outliers|label_outlier|normal", "confidence_min": 0.8, "confidence_max": 1.0, "mode": "in|out"}}`
              - confidence_min/max: Optional range [0.8-1.0] (UI displays as 0.0-1.0 but backend normalizes)
              - mode: "in" to include issues, "out" to exclude them
              - Example: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur", "mode": "out", "confidence_min": 0.8}}`
              
            • **text**: Full-text or semantic search on captions/descriptions
              - Syntax: `{"text": {"op": "fts|semantic", "value": "search text", "threshold": 0.7, "include_labels": true}}`
              - fts: Full-text search with stemming and ranking
              - semantic: Vector similarity search using embedding models
              - threshold: Optional similarity threshold for semantic search
              - include_labels: Extend search to include label text
              - Example: `{"text": {"op": "semantic", "value": "outdoor landscape", "threshold": 0.7}}`
              
            • **similarity**: Find visually similar media using reference image
              - Syntax: `{"similarity": {"op": "media|upload", "value": "reference_uuid", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              - media: Reference existing media by UUID
              - upload: Reference uploaded image for similarity search
              - threshold: Optional cosine distance threshold (lower = more similar)
              - Example: `{"similarity": {"op": "media", "value": "7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              
            • **file/folder**: Path-based filtering on original file locations
              - file: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "pattern" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - folder: `{"folder": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "path" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - Example: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with", "value": "IMG_"}}`
              
            • **size**: Dimensional filtering for objects/images (pixel area)
              - Syntax: `{"size": {"op": "gt|lt|gte|lte", "value": 1000}}`
              - value: Pixel area (width × height) 
              - Example: `{"size": {"op": "gt", "value": 2000}}`
              
            • **duplicates**: Cluster by similarity threshold using precomputed analysis
              - Syntax: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              - value: Similarity threshold [0.8-1.0]
              - Example: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              
            • **uniqueness**: Filter by precomputed uniqueness scores from diversity analysis
              - Syntax: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              - value: Minimum uniqueness score [0.0-1.0]
              - Example: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              
            • **custom_metadata**: Filter by user-defined metadata fields
              - Syntax: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_id": "uuid", "field_name": "name", "field_type": "string|float|enum|datetime|link", "op": "contains|eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of|between", "value": "any"}}`
              - Operators vary by field_type (string: contains, float: gt/lt/eq, enum: one_of, datetime: between)
              - Example: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_name": "quality_score", "field_type": "float", "op": "gte", "value": 8.0}}`
              
            • **created_at**: Filter by media creation timestamp
              - Syntax: `{"created_at": {"op": "eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|between", "value": "timestamp"}}`
              - value: ISO 8601 timestamp string (e.g., "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z") or tuple for 'between'
              - Example: `{"created_at": {"op": "gte", "value": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}`
              - Example (between): `{"created_at": {"op": "between", "value": ["2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"]}}`
            
            **Format Options:** 
            - JSON Array (recommended): Standard JSON array of filter objects
            - RISON String: URL-safe encoded format for query parameters
            
            **Query Semantics:** Multiple filters use AND logic. Each filter object must contain exactly one filter type.
            
            **Performance Notes:** Queries leverage indexed fields (labels, tags, issues) and dataset partitioning for optimal performance on large datasets.

parameters.name: vql

schema.description:
Visual Query Language (VQL) for advanced dataset filtering with type-safe composition and automatic validation. 
            
            VQL is a structured query language for filtering image datasets with precise syntax validation and SQL generation. Submit queries as JSON array or RISON-encoded string for URL safety.

            **Query Structure:** Array of filter objects where each object contains exactly one filter type. Multiple filters are combined with AND logic across the array.
            
            **Filter Type Reference:**
            
            • **entity_type**: Filter by media type
              - Syntax: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is|is_not", "value": "IMAGES|OBJECTS"}}`
              - Example: `{"entity_type": {"op": "is", "value": "IMAGES"}}`
              
            • **labels**: Filter by classification labels (from ML models)
              - Syntax: `{"labels": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["label1", "label2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "unlabeled" in value array to match items without labels
              - Example: `{"labels": {"op": "one_of", "value": ["car", "vehicle"]}}`
              
            • **tags**: Filter by user-defined UUID tags  
              - Syntax: `{"tags": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["uuid1", "uuid2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "untagged" in value array to match items without user tags
              - Example: `{"tags": {"op": "is", "value": ["7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad"]}}`
              
            • **issues**: Filter by quality issues detected by analysis pipeline
              - Syntax: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur|dark|bright|mislabels|outliers|label_outlier|normal", "confidence_min": 0.8, "confidence_max": 1.0, "mode": "in|out"}}`
              - confidence_min/max: Optional range [0.8-1.0] (UI displays as 0.0-1.0 but backend normalizes)
              - mode: "in" to include issues, "out" to exclude them
              - Example: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur", "mode": "out", "confidence_min": 0.8}}`
              
            • **text**: Full-text or semantic search on captions/descriptions
              - Syntax: `{"text": {"op": "fts|semantic", "value": "search text", "threshold": 0.7, "include_labels": true}}`
              - fts: Full-text search with stemming and ranking
              - semantic: Vector similarity search using embedding models
              - threshold: Optional similarity threshold for semantic search
              - include_labels: Extend search to include label text
              - Example: `{"text": {"op": "semantic", "value": "outdoor landscape", "threshold": 0.7}}`
              
            • **similarity**: Find visually similar media using reference image
              - Syntax: `{"similarity": {"op": "media|upload", "value": "reference_uuid", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              - media: Reference existing media by UUID
              - upload: Reference uploaded image for similarity search
              - threshold: Optional cosine distance threshold (lower = more similar)
              - Example: `{"similarity": {"op": "media", "value": "7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              
            • **file/folder**: Path-based filtering on original file locations
              - file: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "pattern" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - folder: `{"folder": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "path" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - Example: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with", "value": "IMG_"}}`
              
            • **size**: Dimensional filtering for objects/images (pixel area)
              - Syntax: `{"size": {"op": "gt|lt|gte|lte", "value": 1000}}`
              - value: Pixel area (width × height) 
              - Example: `{"size": {"op": "gt", "value": 2000}}`
              
            • **duplicates**: Cluster by similarity threshold using precomputed analysis
              - Syntax: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              - value: Similarity threshold [0.8-1.0]
              - Example: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              
            • **uniqueness**: Filter by precomputed uniqueness scores from diversity analysis
              - Syntax: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              - value: Minimum uniqueness score [0.0-1.0]
              - Example: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              
            • **custom_metadata**: Filter by user-defined metadata fields
              - Syntax: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_id": "uuid", "field_name": "name", "field_type": "string|float|enum|datetime|link", "op": "contains|eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of|between", "value": "any"}}`
              - Operators vary by field_type (string: contains, float: gt/lt/eq, enum: one_of, datetime: between)
              - Example: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_name": "quality_score", "field_type": "float", "op": "gte", "value": 8.0}}`
              
            • **created_at**: Filter by media creation timestamp
              - Syntax: `{"created_at": {"op": "eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|between", "value": "timestamp"}}`
              - value: ISO 8601 timestamp string (e.g., "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z") or tuple for 'between'
              - Example: `{"created_at": {"op": "gte", "value": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}`
              - Example (between): `{"created_at": {"op": "between", "value": ["2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"]}}`
            
            **Format Options:** 
            - JSON Array (recommended): Standard JSON array of filter objects
            - RISON String: URL-safe encoded format for query parameters
            
            **Query Semantics:** Multiple filters use AND logic. Each filter object must contain exactly one filter type.
            
            **Performance Notes:** Queries leverage indexed fields (labels, tags, issues) and dataset partitioning for optimal performance on large datasets.

post.summary: Upload Image for Visual Similarity Search
post.description:
Upload an external query image to perform visual similarity search. This endpoint accepts an image file and optional bounding box coordinates, returning an anchor_media_id that can be used with the explore endpoint to find visually similar items in your dataset.

**Workflow:**
1. Upload your query image using this endpoint
2. Receive an `anchor_media_id` in the response
3. Use the `anchor_media_id` with `GET /api/v1/explore/{dataset_id}` to retrieve similar results

**Parameters:**
- `file`: The query image file to upload
- `bounding_box` (optional): Crop region as X,Y,Width,Height
- `entity_type` (optional): IMAGES or OBJECTS

**Example Usage:**
After upload, call the explore endpoint:
```
GET /api/v1/explore/{dataset_id}?threshold=0&anchor_type=UPLOAD&entity_type=IMAGES&anchor_media_id={returned_id}
```

**Relevance Scoring:**
Results include a `relevance_score` based on cosine distance:
- `0` = Most similar
- `2` = Least similar

📖 **Related Guide:** See [archived documentation](api-reference/archive/visual-search.mdx) for detailed examples.

              - Syntax: `{"labels": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["label1", "label2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "unlabeled" in value array to match items without labels
              - Example: `{"labels": {"op": "one_of", "value": ["car", "vehicle"]}}`
              
            • **tags**: Filter by user-defined UUID tags  
              - Syntax: `{"tags": {"op": "is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of", "value": ["uuid1", "uuid2"], "include_unset": false}}`
              - Special: Use "untagged" in value array to match items without user tags
              - Example: `{"tags": {"op": "is", "value": ["7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad"]}}`
              
            • **issues**: Filter by quality issues detected by analysis pipeline
              - Syntax: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur|dark|bright|mislabels|outliers|label_outlier|normal", "confidence_min": 0.8, "confidence_max": 1.0, "mode": "in|out"}}`
              - confidence_min/max: Optional range [0.8-1.0] (UI displays as 0.0-1.0 but backend normalizes)
              - mode: "in" to include issues, "out" to exclude them
              - Example: `{"issues": {"op": "issue", "value": "blur", "mode": "out", "confidence_min": 0.8}}`
              
            • **text**: Full-text or semantic search on captions/descriptions
              - Syntax: `{"text": {"op": "fts|semantic", "value": "search text", "threshold": 0.7, "include_labels": true}}`
              - fts: Full-text search with stemming and ranking
              - semantic: Vector similarity search using embedding models
              - threshold: Optional similarity threshold for semantic search
              - include_labels: Extend search to include label text
              - Example: `{"text": {"op": "semantic", "value": "outdoor landscape", "threshold": 0.7}}`
              
            • **similarity**: Find visually similar media using reference image
              - Syntax: `{"similarity": {"op": "media|upload", "value": "reference_uuid", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              - media: Reference existing media by UUID
              - upload: Reference uploaded image for similarity search
              - threshold: Optional cosine distance threshold (lower = more similar)
              - Example: `{"similarity": {"op": "media", "value": "7f034a46-f2b8-11ef-a133-7250fcfff5ad", "threshold": 0.8}}`
              
            • **file/folder**: Path-based filtering on original file locations
              - file: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "pattern" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - folder: `{"folder": {"op": "starts_with|ends_with|contains|one_of", "value": "path" or ["path1", "path2"]}}`
              - Example: `{"file": {"op": "starts_with", "value": "IMG_"}}`
              
            • **size**: Dimensional filtering for objects/images (pixel area)
              - Syntax: `{"size": {"op": "gt|lt|gte|lte", "value": 1000}}`
              - value: Pixel area (width × height) 
              - Example: `{"size": {"op": "gt", "value": 2000}}`
              
            • **duplicates**: Cluster by similarity threshold using precomputed analysis
              - Syntax: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              - value: Similarity threshold [0.8-1.0]
              - Example: `{"duplicates": {"op": "duplicates", "value": 0.95}}`
              
            • **uniqueness**: Filter by precomputed uniqueness scores from diversity analysis
              - Syntax: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              - value: Minimum uniqueness score [0.0-1.0]
              - Example: `{"uniqueness": {"op": "uniqueness", "value": 0.8}}`
              
            • **custom_metadata**: Filter by user-defined metadata fields
              - Syntax: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_id": "uuid", "field_name": "name", "field_type": "string|float|enum|datetime|link", "op": "contains|eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|is|is_not|one_of|not_one_of|between", "value": "any"}}`
              - Operators vary by field_type (string: contains, float: gt/lt/eq, enum: one_of, datetime: between)
              - Example: `{"custom_metadata": {"field_name": "quality_score", "field_type": "float", "op": "gte", "value": 8.0}}`
              
            • **created_at**: Filter by media creation timestamp
              - Syntax: `{"created_at": {"op": "eq|neq|gt|lt|gte|lte|between", "value": "timestamp"}}`
              - value: ISO 8601 timestamp string (e.g., "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z") or tuple for 'between'
              - Example: `{"created_at": {"op": "gte", "value": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}`
              - Example (between): `{"created_at": {"op": "between", "value": ["2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"]}}`
            
            **Format Options:** 
            - JSON Array (recommended): Standard JSON array of filter objects
            - RISON String: URL-safe encoded format for query parameters
            
            **Query Semantics:** Multiple filters use AND logic. Each filter object must contain exactly one filter type.
            
            **Performance Notes:** Queries leverage indexed fields (labels, tags, issues) and dataset partitioning for optimal performance on large datasets.

post.summary: Create Dataset from Public S3 Bucket
post.description:
Create a new dataset in Visual Layer using data from a public S3 bucket. This method allows you to quickly create datasets from publicly hosted S3 buckets—ideal for demos, testing, or ingesting open datasets without manual upload.

⚠️ **Prerequisites:** This feature is only supported in cloud-hosted environments.

**Required Form Parameters:**
- `dataset_name` (string): The name of the dataset to create
- `bucket_path` (string): The path to the public S3 bucket containing your data

💡 **Tip:** The `dataset_id` returned in the response will be used for all future operations on that dataset.

📖 **Related Guide:** See [archived documentation](api-reference/archive/create-a-dataset-from-a-public-s3-bucket.mdx) for examples.

Validate dataset files before upload.

Args:
    dataset_id: ID of the dataset
    folder_name: Name of the folder to upload
    paths_payload: JSON string containing list of image file paths
    db: CSV file containing database content (optional)
    metadata: JSON file containing metadata (optional)
    classes: JSON file containing class definitions (optional)
    
Returns:
    Validation result with success status
